title: AntiDoubleClickTotem
description: AntiDoubleClickTotem is a client-side Fabric mod that prevents accidental double-clicking of keys in your inventory by adding a small, configurable delay between such presses.
body:
# ENG
AntiDoubleClickTotem is a client-side Fabric mod that prevents accidental double-clicking of keys in your inventory by adding a small, configurable delay between such presses.

# RU
AntiDoubleClickTotem - это клиентский Fabric-мод, который предотвращает случайный дабл-клик по клавишам в инвентаре, добавляя небольшую настраиваемую задержку между такими нажатиями.
